exposure: Characteristics and implementation of Enhanced Maternal and Child Health (EMCH) programs
outcome: Variation in EMCH program structure and delivery
Impact on program evaluation and effectiveness
cohort: The participants were Maternal and Child Health (MCH) coordinators in Victoria who responded to an online survey.
finding: Enhanced Maternal and Child Health (EMCH) programs vary significantly across Victoria in terms of referral criteria, service models, modes of delivery, nurse working conditions, data collection, and clinical tools, with the greatest variation between urban/rural and advantaged/disadvantaged councils.
